remarks: Charming & Sunlit 1-Bedroom in East Norwalk - A Commuter's Dream!  Welcome to 60 Osborne Avenue, where charm and convenience come together in the heart of East Norwalk! Just steps from the train station, this bright and spacious 1-bedroom apartment is perfect for commuters and anyone who loves a vibrant, walkable neighborhood.  Inside, you'll find a sun-filled living space with an inviting eat-in kitchen, ideal for morning coffee or cozy dinners. A bonus room offers flexibility as a home office, nursery, or quiet retreat. The open layout creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere, perfect for relaxing or entertaining.  Enjoy the best of East Norwalk right outside your door! Walk to local cafes, restaurants, and even famous ice cream spots. Outdoor lovers will appreciate the nearby parks, waterfront, and scenic walking trails. Plus, with easy access to major highways, shopping, and Norwalk's stunning coastline, this home offers the perfect balance of tranquility and city convenience.  Don't miss out on this delightful East Norwalk gem-schedule a tour today and see for yourself why 60 Osborne Avenue is the perfect place to call home! Washer and Dryer in the basement.
